business_summary.text: Jain Irrigation Systems Limited operates across the agri value chain with divisions in Hi-Tech (drip irrigation, tissue culture), Plastic (piping, sheets), and Agro Processing (food, beverages). The company is focused on improving margins, reducing debt, and expanding into new beverage and food processing segments.

timeline.summary: Jain Irrigation Systems Limited held Q4/FY26 earnings conference call on May 15, 2026, reporting revenue of ₹1,800 Cr (up 4.3% YoY), EBITDA of ₹236.44 Cr (up 7% YoY), and PAT of ₹-40 Cr, with management expressing cautious optimism for FY27 focusing on debt repayment and cash flow improvement.
Jain Irrigation held Q1FY27 earnings call on August 10, 2026, reporting flat revenue but margin decline due to monsoon delays and polymer price volatility
